Mindful Wholeness

Healing hands with thirty years on them. They come to you.

Sunil gives Shiatsu and reflexology privately at your home in Mumbai, and mindfulness-based counselling in person or online wherever you happen to be. The practice has grown by word of mouth, which is slower than advertising. We are aware of the irony.

Fees are shared on enquiry. WhatsApp messages only, no calls. Complementary therapies, not a substitute for medical or emergency care.

Visit mindfulwholeness.org
